ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour topographic map. In the upper right part, there is a shaded water body labeled Lake L, and several river channels are connected to the lakeshore; near the lake, river sections Jia, Yi, Bing, etc. can be seen, and closer to the middle there is also river section Ding. The contours on the map are marked with values such as 800 and 900. Then reason: The flow direction can be judged according to the bending direction where contours intersect river channels; the regulating effect of a lake on runoff is mainly reflected in the downstream river section after it flows out of the lake, and the closer the downstream river section is to the lake, the more obvious the regulation. In the figure, the river section immediately downstream of Lake L and most directly regulated by the lake water is river section Bing.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure is a contour map of a certain place. Read the figure and answer:

<image1>

In the figure, the runoff of which river section is most obviously regulated by Lake L?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中右上部有L湖，湖边连接若干河道，附近标有甲、乙、丙，较靠中部还有丁。再根据等高线与河道相交处的弯曲方向判断水流方向，确定L湖水流出的下游河段是哪一段。由于湖泊对径流的调节主要表现在出湖后的下游河段，且越靠近湖泊调节越明显，读出紧接L湖下游的河段为丙，因此答案为丙河段。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route solves by first establishing the lake's outlet/downstream direction from contour-line hydrology, then selecting the immediately downstream labelled reach. It is distinct because the decisive step is river-flow direction determination from contour V-shapes/elevation change.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the contour map: locate L湖 in the upper-right part of the diagram; identify the labelled river reaches 甲、乙、丙、丁 around the stream network; observe the river/valley line connected to L湖 and the contour bends crossing it, especially the reach labelled 丙 adjacent to the lake on the downstream side.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording “哪一河段的径流受L湖调节最明显” to focus on the labelled river reach whose discharge is controlled by L湖.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: On a contour map, rivers flow from higher to lower elevation and contour lines form V-shaped bends pointing upstream. A lake most strongly regulates runoff in the river reach immediately downstream of its outlet, not in upstream tributaries or more distant reaches.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：在图中找出L湖及甲、乙、丙、丁四个河段的位置关系。逐一判断它们与L湖的上下游或连通关系：甲、乙不是L湖出水后首先经过的主河段，丁距离L湖较远或不直接紧接湖口；丙位于L湖与主河道相接、承接湖水外泄的位置。依据“湖泊调节最明显的是紧接湖泊下游的出湖河段”这一规则，排除其他河段，选丙河段。
